text: Bitcoin is holding near $65K with minimal daily loss while Ethereum has dipped more sharply to $1,886, suggesting traders are rotating toward perceived safety in the larger cap. The Fear & Greed index at 28 reflects genuine caution, though the modest 7-day uptick hints at stabilization rather than deepening pessimism. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.8% combined with modest $63B daily volume indicates a consolidation phase—neither a panic sell-off nor a confident rally, but a market waiting for direction.
